newsitem.title: USA: Mossimo chief financial officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: Mossimo chief financial officer resigns.

text.p: Mossimo Inc said Wednesday its chief financial officer Anthony Cherbak is leaving the company, for personal and family reasons, to rejoin his former employer, Deloitte & Touche.
Cherbak joined Mossimo in September 1996 after 18 years at Deloitte & Touche.

Corporate controller John Bower has been promoted to vice president of finance and treasurer and will assume Cherbak's duties effective May 29. Cherbak will remain involved with Mossimo on a consulting basis, pursuant to an arrangement between Mossimo and Deloitte & Touche.
Because of Cherbak's rejoining Deloitte & Touche, Mossimo's current auditing and accounting firm, the company is seeking a new indepenent accounting company.
